description: We are F El Kosa, a team of young innovators passionate about technology and agriculture. We aim to solve agricultural challenges through innovative, sustainable, and practical technology-driven solutions.
summary:
**NILORA – Smart & Sustainable Agriculture**

NILORA is a smart agriculture platform designed to help farmers and agricultural engineers make better, data-informed decisions. It combines NASA Earth observation resources, including NASA POWER climate data and NASA GIBS satellite imagery, to provide useful environmental insights and support agricultural planning.

The platform offers dedicated dashboards for farmers and agricultural engineers, climate insights, satellite map visualization, smart recommendations, agricultural reports, and a marketplace for farming products and supplies. Its interface is designed to make agricultural information easier to understand and access, especially for users with limited technical experience.

NILORA addresses the challenge of making Earth observation data more practical and accessible for agriculture. By connecting environmental information with simple digital tools, it aims to help users understand changing conditions, plan their farming activities more effectively, and support more sustainable agricultural practices.

We believe NILORA is important because better access to reliable environmental information can empower farming communities, improve decision-making, and contribute to a more sustainable agricultural future.
details:
NILORA – Smart & Sustainable Agriculture

NILORA is a smart agriculture platform designed to make Earth observation and environmental data more accessible and useful for farmers and agricultural engineers. It addresses the challenge of turning complex climate and satellite information into practical insights that can support everyday agricultural decisions.

The platform integrates NASA Earth observation resources, including NASA POWER climate data and NASA GIBS satellite imagery, alongside Copernicus Sentinel-2 STAC catalogue metadata. These resources help users explore environmental conditions and satellite information through a simple, accessible interface.

NILORA provides separate experiences for farmers and agricultural engineers, with dedicated dashboards and tools. Its features include climate insights, satellite map visualization, agricultural recommendations, reports, and a marketplace for farming products and supplies. The platform aims to simplify access to useful information, help users understand changing environmental conditions, support better agricultural planning, and encourage more sustainable farming practices.

We developed NILORA using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python, with web technologies and APIs for data integration and visualization. We also used Figma for interface design, GitHub for version control and collaboration, and Vercel for deployment.

What makes NILORA creative is its focus on translating complex Earth observation resources into an approachable agricultural experience. Instead of presenting raw scientific data, it organizes information into practical tools designed around the needs of different users. During development, our team considered accessibility, simplicity, mobile responsiveness, data usefulness, and the needs of farming communities.

Our intended impact is to bridge the gap between space-based data and agriculture, empowering farmers and agricultural professionals with better information to make more informed decisions and contribute to a more sustainable agricultural future.
